mapper.sql: id, task_type, CAST(payload AS CHAR) AS payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, next_run_at, last_error
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common_task (task_type, payload, max_attempts, next_run_at) VALUES (#{taskType}, #{payload}, #{maxAttempts}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM common_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND task_type = #{taskType} AND next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_run_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE common_task SET status = 'RUNNING', attempts = attempts + 1, locked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), locked_by = #{worker} WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE common_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', locked_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE common_task SET status = 'PENDING', locked_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, last_error = #{error}, next_run_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE common_task SET status = 'FAILED', locked_at = NULL, last_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE common_task SET status = 'PENDING', locked_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, last_error = '处理超时，已回收' WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND)
